about_the_game:
A Survival Story Where Trust Is Tested

Grim Pastures: Outlaws is a multiplayer social deduction survival game. Set in the nostalgic atmosphere of a 1970s farm, each player takes on the role of a seasonal worker. But danger lurks within the group: killers are hiding among the innocents, aiming to sabotage the production process.

All Wagons Must Be Loaded Before Sunset

Farm orders must be completed and loaded onto the wagons before the sun goes down. Gather the required resources from fields, greenhouses, forests, and barns. As time runs out, finding the right materials and finishing the work becomes critical. Every wasted minute brings the farm closer to collapse.

If You Are an Innocent

Work together to complete all farm orders.

Be cautious while gathering resources — there are those among you who want to disrupt the process.

Choose who to trust wisely, because misplaced trust may end at the gallows.

Innocents can only win by finishing the orders and exposing the killers through voting.

If You Are a Killer

Blend in with the innocents and gain their trust.

Secretly sabotage the production process.

Pretend to help when needed to avoid suspicion.

During voting, manipulate the group and shift the blame onto others.

The Voting System

When suspicion rises, the group comes together to decide. Through voting, one player is sent to the gallows.
A wrong decision may seal the fate of the innocents, while killers can twist the discussion and turn them against each other.

Unique Characters and Powerful Abilities

Each player controls a unique character, each with special abilities:

Doctor – Can prepare healing kits.

Gravedigger – Can reveal the role of a fallen player.

Ghost – Can move unseen for a limited time.

These and other roles bring variety and strategic depth to every match.

Work Together or Sabotage

Each day begins with work on the farm. Innocents try to keep the farm alive, while killers wait for the right moment to strike.
But at the end of the day, the group must decide: Who will be trusted, and who will face the gallows?

In this farm where trust is fragile, will you survive — or will the rope tighten around your own neck?

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6300 / Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 1250 MB available space

short_description: Grim Pastures: Outlaws is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 12 players. Innocents work to fulfill the farm’s orders, while killers secretly sabotage the process. In a voting situation, one player is sent to the gallows. In a farm where trust doesn’t exist, who will you believe?
